_source: https://www.uwindsor.ca/finance/fee-estimator — Windsor's own tuition fee estimator, driven in a browser (it is a Drupal AJAX form that a plain POST cannot complete).
_query: Program type Undergraduate, Course Load Full Time, Fee Category International, Term Fall.
_basis: The figure is Base Tuition, which the estimator itself labels "Assessed each term". It is PER TERM, not annual. Windsor is not annualised here — the same decision taken for uOttawa.
_verification: Each reading was accepted only when the results panel echoed back the major that was requested. An earlier unverified pass raced the AJAX and returned the previous major's figures on 8 of 12 majors.
_note: Estimated Total additionally includes incidental and ancillary fees for that term and varies by programme; Commercial Aviation Leadership is far higher than its base tuition because of flight training charges.
